response.query: What numeric KPIs, acceptable ranges, survey statistical power, and escalation thresholds will define pilot success and trigger mitigation or governance actions?
response.answer: Pilot success is defined by specific numeric KPIs, acceptable ranges, and escalation thresholds. If KPIs fall below acceptable ranges, mitigation or governance actions are triggered. These metrics are essential for ensuring project effectiveness.

results.content: Some positive factors were identified as currently helping meet the health needs of LACYP, including: priority status for LACYP in their referral to particular services; professional cooperation; delegated authority for carers; placement stability and good quality foster placements/positive caring environment; young people being able to open up to somebody they trusted; support services from particular voluntary and statutory organisations; and training around health issues for carers.
